component.name: ApiTask
component.script: sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub sub run() url = m.top.url sep = "?" p = m.top.params esc = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") if p <> invalid then for each k in p url = url + sep + k + "=" + esc.Escape(p[k].toStr()) sep = "&" end for end if ' VK API sometimes stalls for 30+ s: give each attempt 10 s, up to 3 attempts data = invalid for attempt = 1 to 3 ut = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") ut.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") ut.InitClientCertificates() ut.RetainBodyOnError(true) ut.SetUrl(url) port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") ut.SetMessagePort(port) if ut.AsyncGetToString() then msg = wait(10000, port) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" and msg.GetResponseCode() = 200 then data = ParseJson(msg.GetString()) if msg = invalid then ut.AsyncCancel() end if if data <> invalid then exit for end for if data = invalid then data = {error: {error_msg: "ВК не отвечает, попробуйте ещё раз"}} m.top.result = {tag: m.top.tag, data: data} end sub
